stage: Frozen alpha students under physical contact interruption and reconnection

physical.partner: Identical original +X geometry.delta_x_m18.6819cm path, aligned once from existing unforced standing wrist at5.4. Anchor continues its original smoothstep during both disconnects; no reset, pause, chasing wrist or modified target.
physical.disconnect: Harness toggles original Tether cfg.enabled BEFORE each actual physics application, using integer200Hz ticks; original measure/apply computes and applies zero wrench. Sensor sees that real force after original causal delay. Student and gate never receive connection flag, time, onset or anchor.
physical.reconnect: Re-enable original capped spring-damper at same ongoing world anchor; no new force smoothing, stiffness, model or PD changes. This is an ideal detach/regrasp external task perturbation, not fake zero sensor input.

expectations.short: After filter settling, teacher pauses alpha and stays active; Student should retain progress instead of treating0.2s as terminal release or progressing through absent force.
expectations.long: Teacher starts original return after400ms low-force evidence, then reenters continuously from current alpha when real forward force returns. Correct exit/reentry is not an erroneous fresh restart.
expectations.timing_tolerance: Sensor sample +3-frame filter must be accounted for; evaluate short plateau from disconnect+0.06s through reconnect, and trace actual filtered-force events.

qualification.criteria_rationale: 0.05 alpha is5% of the fixed skill path (~3.35deg latent angle), larger than prior full-fit alpha RMS and comparable to prior maximum fit error. Long20% decay is a loose directional exit check, not exact imitation. Same-state shadow teacher uses student's real force history; no labels enter actuation.
qualification.physical: No original safety boundary, falls, support loss or actual joint-limit violation; root speed release+2s<=0.02m/s. Report all action/torque jumps and saturation, no new smoother.
qualification.task: For each Student and condition report active-only XYZ error/force and post-reconnect gain versus paired standing and teacher. Qualification additionally requires post-reconnect3D error below standing. Prior30%/5% criteria reported as historical reference, not silently assumed to apply to changed interruption task.
qualification.decision: No expansion recommendation unless both timing/retention and physical task criteria hold. A failed criterion is retained; do not tune thresholds or checkpoints.

diagnosis: Compare shadow-gate labels/action on visited states, replay gate from320-frame force suffix to test finite sensor-memory sufficiency, and compare training vs visited feature distribution. Saved-data diagnosis only unless a concrete implementation bug needs correction. No retraining or collection for optimization.
stop: Original physical unsafe boundary ends stage. Ordinary source/path/logging bugs may be repaired with preserved records; never tune gate, task, network or model to pass. CUDA model execution only; no CPU fallback.
